The '''Republic Wilderness Outpost''' was a military outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was part of the [[Belsavis prison]], the Republic detention complex built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The Wilderness Outpost was located on the far western edge of the [[High Security Section]], in the region known as the [[Gran Exile]].<ref name="TOR" />
